QuestInfo.name: Blow Up the Containers
QuestInfo.0: Neinheart has put together an explosive to remove the containers blocking the way. Take it and blow your troubles away!
QuestInfo.1: Neinheart has put together an explosive to remove the containers blocking the way. Take it and blow your troubles away!
QuestInfo.2: Neinheart has put together an explosive to remove the containers blocking the way. Take it and blow your troubles away!

0.0: Belle made a simple explosive from the materials you brought, #h0#. Take it and blow up the containers.

yes.0: You'll find the explosive she made in your bag. You must place it as close to the containers as possible.

no.0: This is the quickest way. We don't have time to go around. You must move the containers out of the way quickly.

lost.0: Was there a problem with the explosive? Or did you lose it somewhere? I knew this would happen, so we have a few spares.

yes.0: Please use this one wisely. Explosives don't grow on trees, #ho#.
